About the Hackathon
The MENA Open Gateway Hackathon is an innovation challenge that brings together developers, startups, students, and technology enthusiasts from across the MENA region to build next-generation digital solutions using GSMA Open Gateway CAMARA APIs, the Nokia Network-as-Code platform, and 4G/5G network capabilities.
As the MENA region accelerates its digital transformation through smart cities, digital finance, intelligent mobility, connected enterprises, and immersive tourism, this hackathon provides a platform to develop API-powered applications that solve real-world challenges using network intelligence.
Participants will build solutions across seven challenge themes, demonstrating how standardized network APIs can power secure, scalable, and intelligent digital services while unlocking new business opportunities across the region.
The competition offers exciting rewards, including 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place prizes, along with the opportunity for winning teams to showcase their solutions at MWC Doha (November 2026).
 

 
Objectives of the Hackathon
The hackathon aims to:


Reward innovation by recognizing impactful solutions built using Open Gateway APIs.


Support startup development by helping early-stage ventures validate and showcase their ideas.


Accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies, including CAMARA APIs, Network-as-Code, and 5G.


Build developer capabilities in standardized network APIs and next-generation connectivity.


Foster collaboration between the MENA developer community, regional Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), and telecom technology partners.


Demonstrate the business value of network intelligence through scalable, real-world use cases.


 

 
Eligibility Criteria
Participation is open to individuals and teams from diverse backgrounds, including:


Freelancers


Working Professionals


Early-stage Startups


Students


Developers, Engineers, Designers, Entrepreneurs, Marketers, Innovators—or anyone with a great idea and a passion for technology


Participant Requirements


Participants must be 18 years or older at the time of registration.


No specific educational qualification or prior experience is required.


The hackathon is open to all residents of the member countries of the Arab League and Türkiye

  [&_.muted]:text-muted-foreground"><h1>About the Hackathon</h1>
<p>The <strong>MENA Open Gateway Hackathon</strong> is an innovation challenge that brings together developers, startups, students, and technology enthusiasts from across the MENA region to build next-generation digital solutions using <strong>GSMA Open Gateway CAMARA APIs</strong>, the <strong>Nokia Network-as-Code platform</strong>, and <strong>4G/5G network capabilities</strong>.</p>
<p>As the MENA region accelerates its digital transformation through smart cities, digital finance, intelligent mobility, connected enterprises, and immersive tourism, this hackathon provides a platform to develop API-powered applications that solve real-world challenges using network intelligence.</p>
<p>Participants will build solutions across <strong>seven challenge themes</strong>, demonstrating how standardized network APIs can power secure, scalable, and intelligent digital services while unlocking new business opportunities across the region.</p>
<p>The competition offers exciting rewards, including <strong>1st, 2nd, and 3rd place prizes</strong>, along with the opportunity for winning teams to <strong>showcase their solutions at MWC Doha (November 2026)</strong>.</p>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_069662d.png"></h1>
<h1> </h1>
<h1>Objectives of the Hackathon</h1>
<p>The hackathon aims to:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Reward innovation</strong> by recognizing impactful solutions built using Open Gateway APIs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Support startup development</strong> by helping early-stage ventures validate and showcase their ideas.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies</strong>, including CAMARA APIs, Network-as-Code, and 5G.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Build developer capabilities</strong> in standardized network APIs and next-generation connectivity.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Foster collaboration</strong> between the MENA developer community, regional Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), and telecom technology partners.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Demonstrate the business value of network intelligence</strong> through scalable, real-world use cases.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_069662d.png"></h1>
<p> </p>
<h1>Eligibility Criteria</h1>
<p>Participation is open to individuals and teams from diverse backgrounds, including:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Freelancers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Working Professionals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Early-stage Startups</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Students</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Developers, Engineers, Designers, Entrepreneurs, Marketers, Innovators—or anyone with a great idea and a passion for technology</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Participant Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Participants must be <strong>18 years or older</strong> at the time of registration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>No specific educational qualification or prior experience is required.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>The hackathon is open to <strong>all residents of the member countries of the Arab League and Türkiye</strong></p>
</li>
</ul></div></div><div></div></div></div><div class="border-t border-border mt-12"></div></div><div><div id="themes"><div class="space-y-6"><div class="space-y-4"><div class="text-xl font-bold">Themes</div></div><div class="space-y-0"><div><div class="flex gap-6 py-8"><div class="flex-shrink-0"><div class="relative w-20 h-20 flex items-center justify-center bg-muted dark:bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden"><img alt="1.   [&_.muted]:text-muted-foreground"><h1>Problem Statement</h1>
<p>Build an innovative solution that leverages <strong>GSMA Open Gateway CAMARA APIs</strong>, the <strong>Nokia Network-as-Code platform</strong>, and <strong>5G connectivity</strong> to solve real-world business and everyday challenges across the MENA region.</p>
<p>Your solution should demonstrate how network intelligence can be used to create secure, intelligent, and scalable digital services while addressing a meaningful real-world use case.</p>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_f261eb3.png"></h1>
<h1> </h1>
<h1>Mandatory Requirements</h1>
<p>All submissions must meet the following requirements:</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Utilize CAMARA APIs</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Utilize at least one CAMARA API available on the Nokia Network-as-Code platform. Available APIs include:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>QoS on Demand</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Device Status</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Location Verification</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Location Retrieval</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Geofencing</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Device/Application Attachment</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Network Slicing</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Congestion Insights</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>SIM Swap</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Number Verification</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Build an AI Agent Layer</strong></p>
<p>Every submission must include an AI agent layer that intelligently orchestrates one or more CAMARA APIs as trusted, real-time data sources rather than treating them as simple user-triggered actions.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>The AI agent should:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Make intelligent decisions using telecom network signals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Automate workflows</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Power AI assistant or copilot experiences</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Leverage signals such as Number Verification, SIM Swap, Device Status, Location, and Network Quality</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>The AI agent component must be built <strong>only</strong> using the tools listed in the Resource & Tooling Guide. No external tooling may be used for this component.</p>
<p>Here is the <strong><a href="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-public-ap-south-1/GSMA%20MENA%20Resource%20Guidea254feb.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc">AI Resource and Tooling Guide</a> (mandatory tools for the AI agent layer) </strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Original Solution</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>All submitted code must be original.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>The solution must clearly solve or improve a real-world problem.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Theme Alignment</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Every submission must align with one of the seven hackathon challenge themes.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_f261eb3.png"></h1>
<p> </p>
<h1>Good-to-Have</h1>
<p>The following will strengthen your submission:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Utilize multiple CAMARA APIs available on the Nokia Network-as-Code platform.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build an application optimized for 5G-capable devices.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Demonstrate intelligent orchestration across multiple network APIs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design a scalable, secure, and production-ready solution.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_f261eb3.png"></h1>
<p> </p>
<h1>Restrictions</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p>The submission must utilize 1 or more network API available on Nokia Network-as-Code platform</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>The submission must use original code</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Submissions must use one of the 7 theme categories</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Every submission must include an AI agent layer that orchestrates one or more CAMARA APIs, built using only the tools listed in the linked Resource and Tooling Guide</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p></div></div></div><div class="border-t border-border mt-12"></div></div><div><div id="prizes-rewards"><div class="space-y-6"><div class="text-xl font-semibold">Prizes & Rewards</div><div class="prose max-w-none leading-7 [&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2

  [&_.muted]:text-muted-foreground"><p>The hackathon consists of two evaluation phases. Teams must successfully qualify in <strong>Phase 1</strong> to advance to the <strong>Live Demo Round (Phase 2).</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_f261eb3.png"></h1>
<p> </p>
<h1>Phase 1: Idea Evaluation</h1>
<p>Teams will be evaluated based on their <strong>Idea Capture Template</strong> and <strong>Pitch Deck</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>Relevance</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Alignment with one of the seven MENA challenge themes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Relevance to regional challenges and local context.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Potential to scale across the MENA region.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Clear business model or socio-economic value.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Demonstrates thoughtful planning and effort.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Innovation</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Originality of the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Creative approach to solving the identified problem.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to address meaningful regional pain points.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Complexity & Implementation</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Technical depth and complexity of the proposed solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Clear and easy-to-understand solution design.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Effective utilization of Open Gateway/CAMARA APIs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Feasible and well-defined technical architecture.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>AI agent design that intelligently orchestrates CAMARA APIs using only the approved Resource & Tooling Guide.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_f261eb3.png"></h1>
<p> </p>
<h1>Phase 2: Live Demo Evaluation</h1>
<p>Shortlisted teams will present a working prototype during the live demo round.</p>
<p><strong>Innovation & Originality</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Creativity and uniqueness of the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Innovative application of Open Gateway APIs.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Ability to solve real-world challenges in the MENA region.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value delivered to users, businesses, or society.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Scalability & Commercial Viability</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Potential for large-scale adoption.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sustainable business model.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Commercial readiness beyond the hackathon.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Technical Feasibility & Open Gateway API Usage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Quality and depth of CAMARA API integration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Functionality and stability of the prototype.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Smooth end-to-end user experience.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Agentic AI & Multi-API Orchestration</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Intelligent orchestration of one or more CAMARA APIs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Effective use of AI agents for automation and decision-making.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Presentation & Pitch</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Clarity and structure of the presentation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to communicate the problem, solution, technical approach, and business value.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h1><img alt="" src="https://uc.hackerearth.com/he-s3-ap-south-1/media/sprint/mena-ignite-hackathon/editor/editor_image_2682813_f261eb3.png"></h1>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Evaluation Note</strong></p>
<p>All submissions will be independently reviewed by the judging panel. Teams shortlisted from Phase 1 will advance to the Live Demo round, where the final winners will be selected based on the overall quality, innovation, technical execution, and impact of their solutions.</p></div></div></div><div class="border-t border-border mt-12"></div></div><div><div id="rules"><div class="space-y-6"><div class="text-xl font-semibold">Rules</div><div class="prose max-w-none leading-7 [&:not(:first-child)]:mt-2

metadata.description:
About the Hackathon
The MENA Open Gateway Hackathon is an innovation challenge that brings together developers, startups, students, and technology enthusiasts from across the MENA region to build next-generation digital solutions using GSMA Open Gateway CAMARA APIs, the Nokia Network-as-Code platform, and 4G/5G network capabilities.
As the MENA region accelerates its digital transformation through smart cities, digital finance, intelligent mobility, connected enterprises, and immersive tourism, this hackathon provides a platform to develop API-powered applications that solve real-world challenges using network intelligence.
Participants will build solutions across seven challenge themes, demonstrating how standardized network APIs can power secure, scalable, and intelligent digital services while unlocking new business opportunities across the region.
The competition offers exciting rewards, including 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place prizes, along with the opportunity for winning teams to showcase their solutions at MWC Doha (November 2026).
 

 
Objectives of the Hackathon
The hackathon aims to:


Reward innovation by recognizing impactful solutions built using Open Gateway APIs.


Support startup development by helping early-stage ventures validate and showcase their ideas.


Accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies, including CAMARA APIs, Network-as-Code, and 5G.


Build developer capabilities in standardized network APIs and next-generation connectivity.


Foster collaboration between the MENA developer community, regional Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), and telecom technology partners.


Demonstrate the business value of network intelligence through scalable, real-world use cases.


 

 
Eligibility Criteria
Participation is open to individuals and teams from diverse backgrounds, including:


Freelancers


Working Professionals


Early-stage Startups


Students


Developers, Engineers, Designers, Entrepreneurs, Marketers, Innovators—or anyone with a great idea and a passion for technology


Participant Requirements


Participants must be 18 years or older at the time of registration.


No specific educational qualification or prior experience is required.


The hackathon is open to all residents of the member countries of the Arab League and Türkiye
